transcript.text: Hi everyone. So, the situation is: I have one portable PA system available for informal lending this weekend, and Marco is interested in using it for a neighborhood performance at the park. As I normally do before lending out equipment, I'd like to hear from Marco about the proposed terms — things like when you'd pick it up, when you'd return it, and how you plan to handle setup and care of the system. I'd also like to hear from the park steward about any site requirements we should be aware of. Once I have both of those, I'll make the final call on whether to lend it out and on what terms.

transcript.text: I need to share something important about the site before any lending decision is made. The park coordinator informed me that this performance site permits battery-powered amplification only and caps amplified volume at 85 dB. So whoever uses the PA system will need to make sure it's battery-powered and kept at or below that volume limit.
